"""Declared synthetic REST data and atomic in-memory storage, never runtime data."""

NOW = 1_800_000_000.0


def payload(number=1, *, repository="synthetic", base="auto/integration", **changes):
    row = {
        "number": number,
        "url": f"https://api.github.com/repos/matteocervelli/{repository}/pulls/{number}",
        "html_url": f"https://github.com/matteocervelli/{repository}/pull/{number}",
        "title": f"Synthetic change {number}",
        "body": "Synthetic description",
        "state": "open",
        "created_at": "2026-10-20T00:00:00Z",
        "updated_at": "2026-10-23T00:00:00Z",
        "closed_at": None,
        "merged_at": None,
        "merge_commit_sha": "b" * 40,
        "head": {"ref": "synthetic-work", "sha": "a" * 40},
        "base": {"ref": base, "repo": {"full_name": f"matteocervelli/{repository}"}},
        "labels": [],
    }
    return row | changes


class MemoryStore:
    """All-or-none staged replacement; failure hooks never publish staged bytes."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.data = {"prs.json": b"[]"}
        self.reads = []
        self.writes = 0
        self.fail = ""

    def read(self, name, limit):
        self.reads.append((name, limit))
        value = self.data.get(name)
        return value[:limit] if value is not None else None

    def commit(self, checkpoint, mirror):
        self.writes += 1
        staged = dict(self.data)
        if self.fail == "before_stage":
            raise OSError("synthetic storage fault")
        staged["prs-rest-v1.json"] = checkpoint
        if self.fail == "checkpoint_staged":
            raise OSError("synthetic storage fault")
        if mirror is not None:
            staged["prs.json"] = mirror
        if self.fail == "mirror_staged":
            raise OSError("synthetic storage fault")
        self.data = staged
